reviews.t: Skepticism was met with remarkable results...
reviews.x: I assumed it was more snake oil.  I have been blessed with very little joint pain as I age.  The notable exception is the knuckle that joins my thumb to my hand.  It is sometimes so painful that I have difficulty writing or holding a coffee cup.  A dab rubbed into and around that joint immediately provides remarkable relief.  Of course, "your milage may vary"".  It might not provide similar relief on a knee or shoulder; but, then again, it might.

It arrived right before I left for dinner. Once I applied it, it took about 2 mins to take effect, WORTH IT!  I’ve told several people about it and bought a second jar to carry around with me.

Not sure if it's the emu oil or hemp oil that is reducing the inflammation but I will continue to use this product as long as it keeps me from getting surgery.  It's not a cure all but sure does seem to help reduce inflammation.

I do the same at night before going to bed and it has been wonderful in helping me sleep. It has as a very pleasant scent that fades with 30 minutes. I've been won over! 😃 I'm ordering my 2nd jar today! Love, love this product! ❤️

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the cream effectively relieves pain, including arthritis, back, shoulder, and nerve pain.
Many reviewers note fast relief, often feeling effects within a few minutes to about 10 minutes.
Several reviewers praise the mild, pleasant scent compared to strong menthol or eucalyptus creams.
Some reviewers mention the product is inexpensive or a better value than other CBD products.
A few reviewers report concerns about scent changes or misleading CBD content compared to the brand's website.

qa.q: Does it actually help with joint and muscle discomfort?
qa.answer: Yes, several reviewers report relief from joint and muscle discomfort, including thumb joint pain [1], arthritis pain and swelling plus muscle cramps [2], knee pain [3], knee and lower back arthritis [4], and neck/nerve pain [5]. One reviewer notes pain is not gone but much better [3], and another cautions results may vary [1].

claims.text: A dab rubbed into a painful thumb joint immediately provided remarkable relief.
It helps with pain and swelling due to arthritis and relieves muscle cramps.
Knee pain improved, though pain is not gone but much better.
Applying it to arthritic knees and lower back left the reviewer literally pain free all day.
It reduced neck pain from a pinched nerve after a few applications.

qa.q: How strong is the menthol and eucalyptus smell?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the scent as mild rather than strong: one says it lacks the strong menthol smell of most pain creams [1], and another calls it a very mild fragrance compared to overwhelming eucalyptus ointments [3]. However, one reviewer found the smell not so great and thought it smelled like pickles [2].

claims.text: It does not have the strong menthol smell that most pain relieving creams have.
It has a very mild fragrance compared to overwhelming eucalyptus scented ointments.
One reviewer said the smell was not so great and agreed it smelled like pickles.

qa.q: Is it greasy or does it absorb well?
qa.answer: One reviewer says the cream is not greasy and absorbs when rubbed in [3], while another describes it as rather runny [5]. No review explicitly says it is greasy.

claims.text: The cream is not greasy and absorbs when rubbed in.

qa.q: How long does one 4oz jar last?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it safe for sensitive skin or daily use?
qa.answer: Reviews report no skin irritation for one user [1], and another with severe hand eczema says it completely healed their cracked hands [4]. However, no review explicitly addresses sensitive skin or confirms safety for daily use, so the evidence is limited.

claims.text: One user reported no skin irritation from applying it several times a day [1].
A user with severe hand eczema said the product completely healed their cracked, scaling hands [4].
